verdict.rationale: PlanetScale's Insights feature provides server-side analysis of production traffic—aggregated query stats, failing query patterns, resource anomalies, and schema recommendations—directly inside the product (CLI/dashboard), and community evidence corroborates Insights surfacing actionable suggestions like missing indexes. This goes further into agentic territory with self-improving-database agents that review Insights and open PRs automatically, and MCP integration to expose Insights to AI tools. Missing for 10: independent verification of the self-improving-database agent's real-world accuracy/quality beyond vendor docs, and no direct hands-on user account of the AI-generated schema recommendations specifically (only the Insights index-suggestion anecdote).
